snippet.title: Only Memes
snippet.description:
Welcome to Only Memes! 🐱

I create original short-form comedy built around internet culture and memes.

Every video is built from scratch and edited by me. I research viral trends, write the setup and punchline, and edit the final video using dynamic motion, sound design, visual effects, graphics, captions, and transitions.

I turn each idea into original short-form entertainment with unique pacing, visual storytelling, and comedic context. I combine visual and audio elements to deliver fast-paced jokes that keep viewers engaged from start to finish.

I use Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and CapCut Pro, giving every upload original transformative editing, graphic design, and creative direction.

Daily uploads!

snippet.description:
Two 24 year old best friends from Washington, DC on a mission to promote baseball culture, share players’ stories, and connect fans to the game in English and Spanish ⚾️🌎🔥🎥 

Bringing you all kinds of baseball adventures, interviews, experiences, and more! Subscribe and check us out on Instagram and TikTok too @BatBoysBaseball
